scientific.integrity: The source model and the Section 5 scaling passage were inspected in a search-indexed full-text extraction of the primary article, and the publisher record was checked for date and MSC. The correction is derived directly by substitution. The exact two-season witness and two-step return polynomial are replayed by the bundled symbolic checker. Related full-text periodic Beverton-Holt literature was inspected for implication comparison. Independent audit has not been performed.
scientific.limitations: The result corrects a finite-density scaling claim and does not dispute the source's threshold alpha or its simulation performed with constant density dependence. It does not give a complete parameter-sensitivity theory for arbitrary seasonal density-dependence profiles.

title: Seasonal density dependence cannot be scaled out of the periodic mosquito map
